insights.one_liner: Grant Thornton Netherlands is a 700+ person audit, tax and advisory firm and IND sponsor, popular with Nyenrode and Erasmus graduates.

culture.text: Over 700 professionals work from eight Dutch offices on audit, tax and financial advisory, with headquarters in Alphen aan den Rijn.
Staff mostly studied accounting, economics, tax law and law, often at Nyenrode, Erasmus, VU or University of Amsterdam.
Part of Grant Thornton International, a network of 73,000 professionals in over 150 countries.

open.text: Grant Thornton Accountants en Adviseurs B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor, and it also runs an expatriate services entity.

worth_knowing.text: The Dutch regulator AFM warned Grant Thornton over how it reported an incident from 2023.
